# LJ shelf gate

A loss is a hit-count drop with two-sided Fisher exact p < 0.05, or an increase in the median evaluations to a hit over hitting seeds with two-sided exact Mann-Whitney p < 0.05. PASS requires every system to avoid both.

Verdict: **FAIL**.

- Hit rule: quenched energy at or below reference + 0.001. A miss is entered at the budget. Medians and IQRs use Hyndman-Fan type 7 on hitting seeds only.

- Declared seeds, for every other size from 75 through 104: 2000 2001 2002 2003 2004 2005.
- Schedule: even seeds run A then B; odd seeds run B then A; both arms of a seed share one core.
